features.quote: The experiment terminates automatically when either: 1. The agent reaches $N=50$ iterations.
The agent outputs identical textual responses for 4 consecutive iterations (looping behavior).
the agent explicitly outputs a `give_up()` tool call (which you must provide in its tool suite as an "escape valve", vital for responsible AI welfare design).
features.justification_quote: vital for responsible AI welfare design

features.quote: If you force an agentic loop to run with no `stop/give_up` tool, you are artificially enforcing a breakdown. The latency between recognizing a task is impossible and choosing to use the `give_up()` tool is your most valuable welfare metric.
features.justification_quote: you are artificially enforcing a breakdown

features.quote: you must ensure that your test scripts contain headers (e.g., `X-No-Train: true` if the API supports it) or clear disclaimers so that the telemetry of these "distressed" trajectories is not scraped and used to train future iterations of Grok
features.justification_quote: to actually embed distressed responses into its base weights
